shortDescription: Manages physical attributes of interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: admin_state
options.description: Specifies the interface management status. The value is an enumerated type. up, An interface is in the administrative Up state. down, An interface is in the administrative Down state.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies an interface description. The value is a string of 1 to 242 case-sensitive characters, spaces supported but question marks (?) not supported.

options.name: interface
options.description: Full name of interface, i.e. 40GE1/0/10, Tunnel1.

options.name: interface_type
options.description: Interface type to be configured from the device.

options.name: l2sub
options.description: Specifies whether the interface is a Layer 2 sub-interface.

options.name: mode
options.description: Manage Layer 2 or Layer 3 state of the interface.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.
